description: This file defines types, functions, and logic for resolving and spawning Windows executable programs, including handling command paths, script shims, package.json bin entries, and platform-specific considerations.

methods.name: isFilePath
methods.description: Checks if a given path string points to an existing file.

methods.name: resolveWindowsExecutablePath
methods.description: Resolves the full path to a Windows executable, considering PATH and PATHEXT environment variables.

methods.name: resolveEntrypointFromCmdShim
methods.description: Parses a Windows command shim to find the actual executable or script it points to.

methods.name: resolveBinEntry
methods.description: Resolves the bin entry point from package.json bin field, considering package name.

methods.name: resolveEntrypointFromPackageJson
methods.description: Finds the executable entry point from a package.json file within node_modules or parent directory.

methods.name: resolveWindowsSpawnProgramCandidate
methods.description: Determines the best candidate command to spawn on Windows, handling scripts, binaries, and platform specifics.

methods.name: applyWindowsSpawnProgramPolicy
methods.description: Applies fallback policies to a candidate spawn program, possibly wrapping it in a shell if needed.

methods.name: resolveWindowsSpawnProgram
methods.description: Resolves the final spawn program considering candidate resolution and fallback policies.

methods.name: materializeWindowsSpawnProgram
methods.description: Combines a spawn program with command-line arguments to produce an invocation ready for execution.
